title: Toolpath kind: agent-coding-session v1.0.0
description: Additive constraints on a Toolpath `Path` whose `meta.kind` is the agent-coding-session v1.0.0 URI. Apply alongside the base Toolpath schema; the path is valid when both pass. These constraints are by structural `type`, not by artifact key — a `change` entry is checked only when its `structural.type` matches one this kind defines (`conversation.append`, `file.write`, `conversation.event`). Everything is additive: unmentioned properties are allowed, so producer-specific extras never invalidate a path. The human-readable contract is at https://toolpath.net/kinds/agent-coding-session/v1.0.0/.

tokenUsage.description: Per-turn token accounting. `input_tokens`/`output_tokens` are always emitted (possibly null); cache counters appear only when the source records them.

toolUse.description: One tool invocation. `input` is producer-specific JSON (left unconstrained). `category` is Toolpath's classification, or null when the tool is unrecognized. `result` is present only when the result was available in the same turn.

environment.description: Working environment captured at the turn. All fields optional.

delegation.description: Sub-agent work spawned from a turn. `turns` carries the sub-agent's own turns when the producer inlines them.

conversationAppend.description: The turn payload: the `structural` object of the one `change` entry whose `type` is `conversation.append`. `role` and `text` are always present (text may be empty); everything else appears only when the turn carries it.

fileWrite.description: The `structural` object of a sibling `file.write` change keyed by file path. The unified diff (when present) lives on the artifact change's `raw`, not here. `tool_id`/`tool` link the mutation to the `ToolInvocation` that caused it when attributable.

conversationEvent.description: The `structural` object of a `conversation.event` change — a non-turn entry (attachment, preamble line, snapshot, …) preserved for round-trip fidelity. `entry_type` names the source entry kind; the producer's flattened event data rides alongside.

artifactChange.description: An artifact change, constrained only when its `structural.type` is one this kind defines.

meta.description: Path metadata. `kind` pins this spec; `source` names the producing harness; `producer`/`files_changed`/`vcs_remote` are flattened session-level fields (PathMeta carries `extra` via serde flatten, so they sit directly under `meta`, not under `meta.extra`).
